sentence: Contact wire height at the station throat is below the minimum, slip raised to the section office.
After the strong wind the catenary was seen sagging over one span, and regularisation is to be done in the next block.
Regulation of the sagging span is in progress under power block, and the work is not yet complete.
Handover note: the sag in the overhead near the cabin is still outstanding and the speed caution continues.
Several droppers on the span were found loose, and the contact wire hangs visibly lower than in the neighbouring spans, with height recorded below the minimum.
Contact wire height was measured at every span of the section and no sag was found.
ohe ht ok, no sag
The sag reported earlier was regulated and rechecked within limits, with nothing outstanding on that span.
The reported sag was not borne out when the span was measured, and the wire height is normal.
The wire looks to be sagging slightly in the span near the level crossing, and measurement is pending.
sag? TW to confirm
There may be a possible sag after the storm, but wire height has not been measured yet.
A check for sag was not done on this section, so the status of the wire height is unknown.
Contact wire parted near the turnout and restoration is under way.
cont wire parted at LC, restoration on
The pantograph got entangled with the contact wire at the crossover, and the extent of OHE damage is being assessed.
A cracked insulator was seen on a cantilever and is to be replaced in the next block.
Steady arm found bent after contact with a passing wagon, and wire height was not recorded.
Mast leaning after a road vehicle hit it, and the foundation is being inspected.
Loose jumper at the neutral section was tightened by the maintenance gang.
A tree branch touching the overhead wire was cleared by the gang.
Tower wagon is booked for the Sunday block for routine insulator cleaning.
Gang to report any sagging wire noticed during the walk to the work site.
The OHE patrol roster for the month has been issued, with a patrol every fortnight.
A power block was granted so that track staff could carry out welding work nearby.
OHE foundation digging was held back until S&T shifted their cable route.
OHE defects: Nil.
Overhead equipment was inspected from the tower wagon and no defects were noted.
